scope: Native scientific scalar UInt8 TIFF API, shared editor and pinned ImageJ interoperability
contracts: Finite-only scalar UInt8; C/Z/T and calibration preserved
Source-compatible explicit format enum appended after UInt16/Float32
Version 3 explicit scalar dtype/policy; existing producers retain versions 1/2
Read-free write planning and bounded sample/layout validation
Atomic overwrite and mid-row cancellation preserve prior destination
Physical ordinary/scientific, flat-consent, startup and ordered-append review controls
limitations: RGB, compressed/tiled, BigTIFF and broader metadata profiles remain open
commercial_scope: Original scalar implementation and independent fixtures using the existing reviewed Windows TIFF closure; no upstream Java runtime or classes in products
